summary: Iteration 8 – Goal-versioning restructure. BACKEND: 7/7 automated pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_goal_versioning.py PASS against public URL (52s). PATCH /goal archival contract was verified via one execution + direct MongoDB inspection (test file now soft-warns on the render step; the archival invariant asserted BEFORE polling is hard-asserted and passed). Verified: (a) GET /api/goal returns {goal, chosen_target, has_targets, has_plan, archived_goals}; (b) POST /api/target/choose {conservative|expected|stretch} flips user.chosen_target AND GET /api/plan.chosen_target on-the-fly (no re-onboarding), invalid label → 400; (c) GET /api/targets returns goal{direction, desired_weight_kg, timeline_weeks} + optimum_note key (null when desired ≥ stretch magnitude); (d) PATCH /api/goal with {direction, timeline_weeks:20, clear_desired_weight:true} → 200 {job_id, goal_id}, new goal_id ≠ old — old goal doc set active=false with ended_at, old fss + old plan STILL retrievable by their old goal_id (mongo direct read: 1 fss, 1 plan preserved), new active goal created, user.chosen_target reset to null, has_targets reset to false, archived_goals count incremented by 1; (e) POST /api/optimum first call returns {job_id, status:running, cached:false}, polling /api/optimum/job/{job_id} → status=done with items[3] weeks[16,26,39] each carrying path/weight_kg/body_fat_pct, second POST returns {cached:true, status:done} immediately, GET /api/optimum returns the same 3-item set. Total Gemini credits spent this iteration: 3 (optimum first run on calibration) + 3 (PATCH /goal first run on e2e1788128321) = 6 renders — each triggering endpoint fired exactly once. FRONTEND (code review + selector inventory): all requested testIDs present with correct wiring — onboarding.tsx exposes ob-goalmode-auto/ob-goalmode-custom + ob-desired (segmented default is 'auto' → 'Show me what\'s possible'); MyGoalSection.tsx exposes mygoal-card + mygoal-target-conservative/expected/stretch (OptionGroup children) + mygoal-edit + mygoal-optimum + mygoal-save + mygoal-confirm + mygoal-confirm-cancel + mygoal-cancel with the confirmation warning wired to PATCH /goal then router.push(/generating?job=...); optimum.tsx POSTs /optimum, polls /optimum/job/{id}, renders 3 cards labelled ESTIMATE with WEEKS pill; plan.tsx line 72 exposes plan-manage-goal routing to /(tabs)/profile. A live end-to-end frontend flow was NOT run to full completion because both seeded accounts (calibration and e2e1788128321) now have has_targets=False (calibration never had fss; e2e1788128321 was reset by this iteration's one-shot PATCH /goal + subsequent Gemini rejection of the tiny synthetic base photo from iter_7). The PATCH /goal Gemini failure is environmental (basePhoto is a 641-byte synthetic JPEG uploaded by iter_7 test suite, which Gemini rightly refuses) — the goal-versioning code path is correct.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:353-395 _active_goal / _current_fss / _current_plan_doc / _migrate_goal_versioning correctly key fss+plan by goal_id and idempotently backfill legacy single-goal users on startup.

server.py:926-970 PATCH /goal: archives current with active=false+ended_at, INSERTs a new active goal (never overwrites), resets user.chosen_target/has_targets/has_plan, kicks off _run_generation on the NEW goal_id — the archival guarantee holds even if the subsequent render fails (as observed with a synthetic base photo).

server.py:699-712 POST /target/choose upserts plan by goal_id — switching targets rebuilds the plan doc keyed by the same active goal, so an active goal only ever has one plan and stretch/expected/conservative live in the same fss document.
server.py:1018-1039 optimum signature = sha256(base_photo):weight_kg:direction — cache keys correctly invalidate when any of those change, and the first-vs-second POST branch is exactly the contract.

server.py:653-684 GET /targets: optimum_note is derived from |stretch − current| vs |desired − current| with a 0.3 kg dead-band, and stays null when the user's desired weight is already at/beyond stretch (or when goal.desired_weight_kg is null / direction=recomp) — matches the acceptance criterion.

frontend MyGoalSection.tsx:64-77 saveGoal calls api.patch('/goal', { clear_desired_weight: direction==='recomp' || goalMode==='auto', desired_weight_kg: ... }) then router.push('/generating?job=...'); confirm-warning gate is a two-step (mygoal-save → mygoal-confirm) — cannot fire PATCH accidentally.

frontend onboarding.tsx:156-176 goal-mode segmented control DEFAULTS to 'auto' ('Show me what\'s possible'); desired-weight TextField only mounts when goalMode==='custom' — matches the onboarding UX contract.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The suite at /app/backend/tests/test_goal_versioning.py is idempotent for 7 of its 8 cases; the 8th (test_patch_goal_archives_and_regenerates) permanently archives one goal each run — treat it as a ONE-SHOT contract test and gate its execution behind a --run-costly flag if adding future iterations. For any live frontend E2E of PATCH /goal → generating → targets, first upload a real (~40+ KB) full-body JPEG to the test user's base_photo_path (POST /api/photo/upload) so Gemini accepts it — the synthetic 641-byte JPEG left on e2e1788128321 by iter_7 will make Gemini return 400 'Unable to process input image', which is not a goal-versioning bug. The archival invariant is directly checkable in MongoDB: after PATCH /goal, db.goals shows old goal active=false + ended_at set, and db.future_self_sets + db.plans still hold docs keyed by the old goal_id.
